br-nig-glaubenbielen-entlebuch-flow.title: Brünig · Glaubenbielen · Entlebuch Flow
br-nig-glaubenbielen-entlebuch-flow.slogan: Two passes and 170 km, high point 1611 m
br-nig-glaubenbielen-entlebuch-flow.story: A mountain day with softer edges and excellent coffee logic. A 170 km loop that starts and ends near Luzern, about 3 h 15 of riding. On the way it passes Entlebuch and Giswil. The climbs: Glaubenbielen high road and Brünigpass sweepers. It tops out at 1,611 m. Brunig Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 28 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1611 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grimsel Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: 14 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
